# Three Month Vision

---

> [!question] Prompt
>
> Write in the present tense as if it is three months in the future.
>
> Where do I want to be and how do I want to feel in three months?

## Personal

- I know when to back down, but do not give up easily
- I manage my energy and stress levels
- I have systems in place to reduce my stress when I get overwhelmed
- I make time for energy gaining activities, such as reading and exercising
- I do not lament not doing something important to me; instead, I learn from my mistakes, both big and small
- I am not afraid of failure; I view failure as a gift
- I am not afraid to reflect and take time to think when I feel rushed
- I make time to review and reflect on my life and do not let it pass me by

## Interpersonal

### Romantic Relationship

- I make space, emotionally and physically, to let Sam in
- I dedicate time, effort, and thought to improving my relationship with Sam
- Once a week, I do something for Sam to show her I love and care about her
- Because I know that Sam loves me and wants what is best for me, I give her the benefit of the doubt even when she annoys or upsets me

### Friends

- I keep in touch with friends
- I make an effort into strengthening my relationships
- I know that friends are the best remedy to anxiety and depression
- I put aside energy for my friends
- I go out with a friend at least once every two weeks
- Through my actions, I let my friends know how important they are to me

## Professional

### Work

- I finish my workday with spare energy
- For the majority of the time, I finish my day satisfied and excited for the next
- I clearly separate my workday from the rest of the day
- I leave work at work
- I automate as much as my job as possible in order to make time for activities and tasks that interest me

### Academic

- I am on top of my studies
- I recognize when I am procrastinating and do not make excuses
- I learn and complete assignments without needing the pressure of a deadline
- I love learning again
